unitIntroduction: 12 of the 60 explanation minutes. NIST laboratory photograph connects endpoints and human decisions to precision measurement; five-lesson route and 22h budget.
boundaries: No mean, spread calculation, probability, propagation, calibration correction, plotting library, extra assessment or compulsory purchase. Terms are introduced only as needed; detailed precision/reporting in L04.
media: Actively searched NIST instrument/ruler imagery. Metric ruler front marked copyrighted rejected. Selected Bruce Borchardt/NIST measurement photo and NIST tape-mark microscopy under NIST unmarked-information copying terms; original diagrams complement them. No video/animation: static scale and event comparisons support this lesson without new controls; no quota.
forward: U02-L02 remains approved 4h/1h Python plan: compare repeats, common offset and controlled conditions, retaining raw values. U03 remains 20h motion/data outline. U02-L05 retains cumulative exercises, conclusion and brief web/PDF reference within its existing 5h budget. Later B02 mechanics uses these records; A101 applies provenance; M102 owns probability and later modules formal inference.
releaseDisposition: Unpublished; preview switch only. Learner review is the next milestone after checks. No reduction of standard requested.
